description: This file defines structures and function declarations related to environment variable management within the lighttpd web server project. It includes definitions for environment data structures, functions for manipulating environment variables, and mechanisms for creating environment duplicates.
external_methods: GString* li_environment_get(liEnvironment *env, const gchar *key, size_t keylen)
GString* li_environment_dup_pop(liEnvironmentDup *envdup, const gchar *key, size_t keylen)

methods.name: li_environment_init
methods.description: Initializes the environment structure by creating its internal table.

methods.name: li_environment_reset
methods.description: Resets the environment, removing all entries.

methods.name: li_environment_clear
methods.description: Clears and destroys the environment's internal table.

methods.name: li_environment_set
methods.description: Sets or overwrites an environment variable with the given key and value.

methods.name: li_environment_insert
methods.description: Inserts a new environment variable; does not overwrite existing entries.

methods.name: li_environment_remove
methods.description: Removes an environment variable by key.

methods.name: li_environment_get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable.

methods.name: li_environment_make_dup
methods.description: Creates a read-only duplicate of the current environment.

methods.name: li_environment_dup_pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the value for a key from the duplicate environment.

methods.name: li_environment_dup2cgi
methods.description: Calls a callback for environment variables to convert environment to CGI variables, handling duplicates accordingly.
